errors.trigger: A scalar flag is repeated or command options conflict.
errors.remediation: Provide each scalar flag at most once and use --help by itself.

errors.trigger: A JSON argument or input cannot be read, uses an unsupported carrier, is empty, has invalid syntax, or has a non-object top level.
errors.remediation: Use the parameter's declared carrier and provide readable UTF-8 content containing one JSON object. Follow the specific failure remediation.

errors.trigger: Shared terminal Closure result reader is unavailable.
errors.remediation: Provide the shared read-only Closure result API.

Preserve the original command, exit status, stdout and stderr; the cause of this internal failure is not established. Report it to guru-finish-task maintenance, then use this owner's original recovery after repair without repeating completed Git/GitHub mutations.

errors.trigger: The selected archived Task bytes or mode differ from the physical source supplied to this original owner.
errors.remediation: Reread the exact selected archive through the original maintenance owner; preserve its frozen source and any later work.
